SELECT c.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_2012
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID AND ym.Date LIKE '2012%'
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY total_2012 ASC
LIMIT 5

FROM customers c WHERE Segment='LAM'
